sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pistols is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Pistol handling skill improves the overall handling, reduces recoil and reload time of pistols.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases reload speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases weapon switching speed (0.8% per level → +40% at Elite Level)
- Reduces weapon recoil (0.3% per level → -15% at Elite Level)
- Improves weapon ergonomics (0.2% per level → +10% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Steady aim for the first 3 seconds with any stamina condition
- Elite level: Doubles mastering gain

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Landing hits on enemies with Pistols
- Reloading Pistols
- Cycling the action/Unloading the chambers of Pistols
- Completing the quest Escort
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
- Completing the quest Special Equipment
- Completing the quest Trophies
